title: Can a Gal Be Kind to Otaku?
overview: An awkward otaku is surprised to find himself becoming friends with two of the most popular girls at school.

title: Is My Room a Hangout Spot for Gals?!
overview: Ijichi and Amane insist on visiting Seo's house after school for an impromptu Glittery Monpets viewing party.

title: Do You Want to Come Over?
overview: Quiet otaku Takuya suddenly befriends two very different gals, bonding with them over anime and fandom.

title: Let's Go to Karaoke
overview: After an intense sports day at school, the gals take Seo out for an afternoon of Glittermon songs at karaoke.

title: So? You Like Our Swimsuits?
overview: Seo and the gals enjoy a sunny day at the beach with three of Ijichi's brothers and Amane's young friend Sayu.

title: Love?
overview: Amane asks Seo to help out at a photo shoot and then the three friends visit a festival with a fireworks show.

title: You're a Real Pickup Artist, Otaku-kun
overview: The second semester begins. For Seo, Amane, and Ijichi, everyday life in their “like” based relationship starts anew. However, after a classroom seat change, Seo suddenly finds himself farther away from Ijichi than before... And then, preparations begin for the biggest event of the second semester: the school festival! As the class decides what attraction to put on, the members of Class 1-A, including Seo, begin secretly planning something centered around Amane and Ijichi.

title: A Slumber Party? No Way!
overview: Guided by Ijichi, Seo arrives at Genichiro’s house. Amane soon joins them, and the three begin preparing for the school festival together after class. Then, when Ijichi realizes the next day is a holiday, she suddenly proposes having a “sleepover” right then and there! Faced with the extraordinary situation of “staying overnight with girls,” Seo completely panics, but beside him, Amane doesn’t seem entirely against the idea either.
